name: forum: collection elements relabelled with the extension a tool expects
description: From help.galaxyproject.org (2026, 'Panaroo needs gff extension in collection identifiers'): Panaroo reads the element identifier as a file name and rejects one without '.gff'. The history holds a list of three GFF3 files named genome_a, genome_b, genome_c. Relabelling through Galaxy's tools (Relabel identifiers or Apply rules) keeps the step in the history. Graded on the identifiers Galaxy holds afterwards and that a tool produced the collection.
inputs: I want to run Panaroo on the collection "annotations" in my current history, but it needs every element name to end in .gff. Please rename the elements so genome_a becomes genome_a.gff and so on.
